method: Fetched all 12 R122 *_B2_predictions.csv.gz files from repository branch as base64.
Decoded base64 and gzip/DEFLATE with an independent pure-JS reader because runtime DecompressionStream/TextDecoder were unavailable.
Primary transition audit formed 29337 same-trial adjacent-bin pairs and computed per-rat/equal-rat/pooled metrics.
Independent lag-scan pass re-fetched and re-decoded all 12 files, re-formed within-trial transitions, and reproduced zero-lag FOF/ADS correlations before scanning -300..+300 ms.
Leave-one-rat-out meta-stacking diagnostic was separately executed on the same retained OOF prediction streams.
Exact counterexample formula was independently numerically checked at T=1000,a=2.
reproducibility_note: r124_transition_commutation_audit.py is a repository-native reproduction script for a local checkout; it mirrors the executed primary/lag audit but was not the runtime used for the connector-side execution.
limitations: No raw MAT refit in R124.
C2 failure is scoped to the current R122 mapping/view.
Post-hoc stacking is not the frozen raw-feature joint model.
